help.stdout:
Usage: blueprint [options] [command]

Blueprint V3 Enterprise - Cognitive Platform CLI

Options:
  -V, --version        output the version number
  -v, --verbose        Enable verbose output
  -q, --quiet          Suppress output
  --json               Output in JSON format
  -c, --config <path>  Path to configuration file
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]       Initialize a new Blueprint project
  compile [options]    Compile Blueprint DSL to bytecode
  build [options]      Build a Blueprint package
  run [options]        Run a Blueprint program
  graph [options]      Generate dependency/knowledge/runtime graphs
  trace [options]      Enable runtime tracing
  debug [options]      Attach debugger to running program
  benchmark [options]  Run all benchmarks
  doctor [options]     Check system health and configuration
  completion [shell]   Generate shell completion script
  help [command]       display help for command
